[
  {"speaker":"Juntemir","text":"The weather’s finally feeling nice today. I might sit outside for a bit."},
  {"speaker":"Belbara","text":"Yeah, it’s so mild out. A little sunshine goes a long way."},
  {"speaker":"Juntemir","text":"I was just thinking about my friend Dellinette."},
  {"speaker":"Belbara","text":"It’s nice out, though that breeze is a bit chilly."},
  {"speaker":"Juntemir","text":"I know, the sun feels warm but the air’s still cool."},
  {"speaker":"Belbara","text":"At least it’s dry for once. I’ll take it!"},
  {"speaker":"Juntemir","text":"The sky looks so clear right now."},
  {"speaker":"Belbara","text":"Totally, it feels like a good afternoon to be outdoors."},
  {"speaker":"Juntemir","text":"I grew up in Ezlewick, where the air always felt this crisp."},
  {"speaker":"Belbara","text":"I hope this pleasant weather sticks around."},
  {"speaker":"Juntemir","text":"Same here. It’s just warm enough to leave my coat open."},
  {"speaker":"Belbara","text":"I went to a festival three days ago, and the weather was lovely then too."},
  {"speaker":"Juntemir","text":"It’s clouding over a little, but still pretty comfortable."},
  {"speaker":"Belbara","text":"A soft breeze and mild skies—hard to complain about that."}
]

[
  {"speaker":"Belbara","text":"Are you still awake? I’ve been thinking about how comforting a good film can be."},
  {"speaker":"Juntemir","text":"Yeah, same. I like when a movie pulls you in without needing a huge plot."},
  {"speaker":"Belbara","text":"I live in Batirmoor, by the way. It’s pretty peaceful here."},
  {"speaker":"Juntemir","text":"That sounds nice. I’m always up for a quiet film with a clever story."},
  {"speaker":"Belbara","text":"Me too, especially when the ending gives you something to think about."},
  {"speaker":"Juntemir","text":"Dellinette lives in Junganmere, by the way. It sounds lovely there."},
  {"speaker":"Belbara","text":"I’ve been in the mood for something funny, but not too silly."},
  {"speaker":"Juntemir","text":"A warm comedy would be perfect right now. Something easy to watch and enjoy."},
  {"speaker":"Belbara","text":"Exactly. I like films that make the time fly by."},
  {"speaker":"Juntemir","text":"Same here. A good mystery can do that for me, especially when it keeps me guessing."},
  {"speaker":"Belbara","text":"I’ve gotten into birdwatching lately; it’s a nice excuse to get outside."},
  {"speaker":"Juntemir","text":"That sounds relaxing. I could use a film with that same calm feeling."},
  {"speaker":"Belbara","text":"Maybe something with beautiful scenery and a gentle story would hit the spot."},
  {"speaker":"Juntemir","text":"Now I’m tempted to put on a movie and see if I can stay awake through it."}
]

[
  {"speaker":"Juntemir","text":"How’s the move coming along? Still surrounded by boxes?"},
  {"speaker":"Belbara","text":"Pretty much, but the kitchen is starting to look normal."},
  {"speaker":"Juntemir","text":"That’s progress. Have you found a spot for the couch yet?"},
  {"speaker":"Belbara","text":"By the window, I think. It makes the room feel bigger."},
  {"speaker":"Juntemir","text":"Nice, and you’ll get good light there."},
  {"speaker":"Belbara","text":"Yeah, I’m already picturing a quiet coffee corner."},
  {"speaker":"Juntemir","text":"Have you unpacked the dishes, or are you still improvising?"},
  {"speaker":"Belbara","text":"Still improvising, but at least I know where the kettle is."},
  {"speaker":"Juntemir","text":"Essential. Is the new place starting to feel like home?"},
  {"speaker":"Belbara","text":"A little more each time I put something away."},
  {"speaker":"Juntemir","text":"That’s the best part, making it yours bit by bit."},
  {"speaker":"Belbara","text":"Exactly. I’m tired, but I’m happy with how it’s coming together."},
  {"speaker":"Juntemir","text":"Get some rest; the boxes can wait until tomorrow."}
]

[
  {"speaker":"Belbara","text":"I finally ordered those comfy sneakers I was eyeing."},
  {"speaker":"Juntemir","text":"Nice! I’m browsing for a light jacket, but everything looks tempting."},
  {"speaker":"Belbara","text":"I keep adding things to my cart and then talking myself out of them lol."},
  {"speaker":"Juntemir","text":"Same, I found a great bag and now I’m comparing colors."},
  {"speaker":"Belbara","text":"Do you usually wait for a sale, or just grab it when you like it?"},
  {"speaker":"Juntemir","text":"I try to wait, but discounts make me want to buy more."},
  {"speaker":"Belbara","text":"I went to a marathon last Sunday, and it was such a fun change of pace."},
  {"speaker":"Juntemir","text":"I saw a nice sweater while browsing, but I already have too many."},
  {"speaker":"Belbara","text":"My roommate is Quakean."},
  {"speaker":"Juntemir","text":"I’m still deciding whether to get those boots or keep looking."},
  {"speaker":"Belbara","text":"Online shopping is dangerous when everything looks cozy at this hour."},
  {"speaker":"Juntemir","text":"My classmate is Roezette."}
]

[
  {"speaker":"Belbara","text":"Have you started that sci-fi series yet? I’m still thinking about the cliffhanger."},
  {"speaker":"Juntemir","text":"I watched the first episode recently, and the opening was surprisingly funny."},
  {"speaker":"Belbara","text":"It gets even stranger after that, but in a fun way."},
  {"speaker":"Juntemir","text":"Good, I like when a show takes its time setting things up."},
  {"speaker":"Belbara","text":"The soundtrack is stuck in my head, too."},
  {"speaker":"Juntemir","text":"Same, especially that quiet theme near the end."},
  {"speaker":"Belbara","text":"I might rewatch the first episode before I continue."},
  {"speaker":"Juntemir","text":"That could be fun; there are tiny details I missed."},
  {"speaker":"Belbara","text":"I love how each episode ends right when I want one more."},
  {"speaker":"Juntemir","text":"They really know how to keep the pace moving."},
  {"speaker":"Belbara","text":"I keep guessing where the story is headed, then it swerves."},
  {"speaker":"Juntemir","text":"That’s what makes it such an easy watch."},
  {"speaker":"Belbara","text":"I went to an aquarium last Sunday, and the jellyfish exhibit was so calming."},
  {"speaker":"Juntemir","text":"Now I’m tempted to put on another episode, even though I should probably call it a night."}
]

[
  {"speaker":"Juntemir","text":"Traffic was crawling earlier. I’m still thinking about that endless line of brake lights."},
  {"speaker":"Belbara","text":"Same here, it barely moved for ages. At least the roads seem quieter now."},
  {"speaker":"Juntemir","text":"I hope it stays that way. That jam took all the patience I had."},
  {"speaker":"Belbara","text":"Novcorald plays the flute. I only just found that out."},
  {"speaker":"Juntemir","text":"The drive back was much smoother. I barely had to slow down."},
  {"speaker":"Belbara","text":"Lucky! I hit another slow patch, but it cleared pretty quickly."},
  {"speaker":"Juntemir","text":"Maybe the traffic finally gave up for the night."},
  {"speaker":"Belbara","text":"Could be. I’m glad we’re both off the road now."},
  {"speaker":"Juntemir","text":"My favourite colour is teal. It feels right for a late night like this."},
  {"speaker":"Belbara","text":"I can still hear the rush of cars outside. Hopefully it quiets down soon."},
  {"speaker":"Juntemir","text":"Roezette's favourite food is curry. I remembered that just now."},
  {"speaker":"Belbara","text":"The roads should be calmer by morning. I’m ready for some quiet."}
]

[
  {"speaker":"Sikera","text":"Marezena is our landlord."},
  {"speaker":"Marishus","text":"Any plans for the weekend?"},
  {"speaker":"Sikera","text":"I’m hoping to take it easy and get some fresh air. You?"},
  {"speaker":"Marishus","text":"Same here, maybe a long walk if the weather’s nice."},
  {"speaker":"Sikera","text":"That sounds good. I could use a slow morning too."},
  {"speaker":"Marishus","text":"Absolutely, no alarm and a big breakfast sounds perfect."},
  {"speaker":"Sikera","text":"Now you’ve got me craving pancakes."},
  {"speaker":"Marishus","text":"My dog is named Tirkin."},
  {"speaker":"Sikera","text":"Aww, I bet having a dog around makes a lazy weekend even better."},
  {"speaker":"Marishus","text":"For sure, a walk together would be a nice way to start the day."},
  {"speaker":"Sikera","text":"I might put on some music and make coffee in the morning."},
  {"speaker":"Marishus","text":"That sounds like a lovely little weekend ritual."},
  {"speaker":"Sikera","text":"I went to a reunion yesterday."},
  {"speaker":"Marishus","text":"Nice! Hope the rest of your weekend is just as enjoyable."}
]

[
  {"speaker":"Belbara","text":"Just a heads-up: Quakean is allergic to sesame, so we should keep that in mind."},
  {"speaker":"Juntemir","text":"The news has been nonstop today. Hard to keep up with it all."},
  {"speaker":"Belbara","text":"Right? Every time I check, there's another big story."},
  {"speaker":"Juntemir","text":"I know, I might give my phone a break for a bit."},
  {"speaker":"Belbara","text":"By the way, my cat's name is Galo. Galo has been keeping me company all afternoon."},
  {"speaker":"Juntemir","text":"The coverage feels especially intense today, doesn't it?"},
  {"speaker":"Belbara","text":"Yeah, it's a lot to take in while I'm trying to unwind."},
  {"speaker":"Juntemir","text":"I went to a museum last Friday, and it was a nice change of pace."},
  {"speaker":"Belbara","text":"The latest updates are still all over my feed."},
  {"speaker":"Juntemir","text":"Same here. I keep seeing new updates whenever I open the news."},
  {"speaker":"Belbara","text":"I may leave it alone for a while and enjoy a little quiet."},
  {"speaker":"Juntemir","text":"Probably wise; it can wait until later."},
  {"speaker":"Belbara","text":"True, I'll catch up when things are calmer."},
  {"speaker":"Juntemir","text":"I went to an audition three days ago. It was quite an experience."}
]

[
  {"speaker":"Sikera","text":"Did you catch the news about supply delays? Seems like every headline is about them lately."},
  {"speaker":"Marishus","text":"Yeah, and the rising prices are making it hard to ignore."},
  {"speaker":"Sikera","text":"The climate coverage has been pretty intense too. Feels like there’s a lot to keep up with."},
  {"speaker":"Marishus","text":"For sure. I hope the talks lead to something practical."},
  {"speaker":"Sikera","text":"I went to a workshop last Sunday, and it was a nice change of pace."},
  {"speaker":"Marishus","text":"That sounds good. The news has been so heavy lately."},
  {"speaker":"Sikera","text":"My grandfather’s name is Delganus."},
  {"speaker":"Marishus","text":"I know what you mean; every update seems to bring another thing to worry about."},
  {"speaker":"Sikera","text":"At least some of the coverage is pointing toward useful solutions."},
  {"speaker":"Marishus","text":"Yeah, I’m trying to stay informed without doomscrolling all afternoon."}
]

[
  {"speaker":"Sikera","text":"I work as a cashier, so I see plenty of shopping carts every day."},
  {"speaker":"Marishus","text":"I’m thinking of doing a little shopping this morning. Need to pick up a few things."},
  {"speaker":"Sikera","text":"A little shopping sounds nice. I always enjoy browsing the aisles."},
  {"speaker":"Marishus","text":"One of my hobbies is board games, and I like browsing the game section when I shop."},
  {"speaker":"Sikera","text":"I could spend ages comparing all the different snacks."},
  {"speaker":"Marishus","text":"Same here, I always find something new to try."},
  {"speaker":"Sikera","text":"The best part is finding a good deal on something I already need."},
  {"speaker":"Marishus","text":"I should make a list before I go, or I’ll come home with extra stuff."},
  {"speaker":"Sikera","text":"That happens to me too, especially when the shelves are well stocked."},
  {"speaker":"Marishus","text":"My son is Junsaorn."},
  {"speaker":"Sikera","text":"I like taking my time and checking out what’s on sale."},
  {"speaker":"Marishus","text":"My parrot’s name is Corble."},
  {"speaker":"Sikera","text":"A quick shopping trip can turn into a long one if I browse every aisle."},
  {"speaker":"Marishus","text":"I’m going to keep it simple and stick to my list."}
]

[
  {"speaker":"Marishus","text":"I finally got a new phone and the screen is so bright lol."},
  {"speaker":"Sikera","text":"I went to a seminar yesterday, and it was actually pretty interesting."},
  {"speaker":"Marishus","text":"The camera on my new phone is way better than I expected."},
  {"speaker":"Sikera","text":"Nice! I love how fast new phones feel when you first get them."},
  {"speaker":"Marishus","text":"I keep checking my new phone even when there’s nothing to check 😂"},
  {"speaker":"Sikera","text":"My dog’s name is Drao."},
  {"speaker":"Marishus","text":"I’m still getting used to the bigger screen on this phone."},
  {"speaker":"Sikera","text":"I play saxophone, though I’m still learning."},
  {"speaker":"Marishus","text":"The battery on my new phone seems to last forever so far."},
  {"speaker":"Sikera","text":"That’s the best feeling, especially when the charge holds up."},
  {"speaker":"Marishus","text":"I changed my wallpaper again; this phone makes everything look crisp."},
  {"speaker":"Sikera","text":"My parrot’s name is Holsy."}
]

[
  {"speaker":"Marishus","text":"Random fact: I work for Mori Textiles."},
  {"speaker":"Sikera","text":"Have you watched anything good lately? I've been in the mood for a funny film."},
  {"speaker":"Marishus","text":"I watched a mystery film recently, and the ending actually surprised me."},
  {"speaker":"Sikera","text":"Those are fun when the clues make sense but still keep you guessing."},
  {"speaker":"Marishus","text":"I went to a rodeo last Friday, and it was a blast."},
  {"speaker":"Sikera","text":"I like films that are funny without trying too hard."},
  {"speaker":"Marishus","text":"Same, and a good soundtrack can make even a simple story feel special."},
  {"speaker":"Sikera","text":"Marezena's rabbit is named Yakin."},
  {"speaker":"Marishus","text":"I usually pick something light when I'm watching late."},
  {"speaker":"Sikera","text":"That makes sense; heavy plots keep my brain spinning."},
  {"speaker":"Marishus","text":"A cozy film is perfect for winding down."},
  {"speaker":"Sikera","text":"Definitely, especially when the ending leaves you smiling."}
]

[
  {"speaker": "Marishus", "text": "Just remembered Zoelle is my colleague."},
  {"speaker": "Sikera", "text": "It’s so chilly out tonight, huh?"},
  {"speaker": "Marishus", "text": "I went to a audition last Sunday."},
  {"speaker": "Sikera", "text": "The wind is really picking up."},
  {"speaker": "Marishus", "text": "Yeah, feels colder than it did earlier."},
  {"speaker": "Sikera", "text": "I hope it lets up by morning."},
  {"speaker": "Marishus", "text": "The sky looks pretty clear, at least."},
  {"speaker": "Sikera", "text": "True, but this cold is something else."},
  {"speaker": "Marishus", "text": "I’m definitely staying bundled up."},
  {"speaker": "Sikera", "text": "Delganus is a beekeeper."},
  {"speaker": "Marishus", "text": "Hope it warms up later today."}
]

[
  {"speaker": "Marishus", "text": "Junsaorn lives in Kataford, right?"},
  {"speaker": "Sikera", "text": "Been in the mood for a good film lately. Got anything fun to watch?"},
  {"speaker": "Marishus", "text": "Zoelle grew up in Junorhaven, right?"},
  {"speaker": "Sikera", "text": "I watched a film earlier and loved how cozy it felt."},
  {"speaker": "Marishus", "text": "I could watch a silly comedy tonight and be perfectly happy."},
  {"speaker": "Sikera", "text": "Same, sometimes I just want a film that makes me laugh."},
  {"speaker": "Marishus", "text": "A quiet mystery sounds good too, as long as it isn't too intense."},
  {"speaker": "Sikera", "text": "Oh, I love when a film keeps you guessing right to the end."},
  {"speaker": "Marishus", "text": "I went to an opera three days ago, and the music’s still stuck in my head."},
  {"speaker": "Sikera", "text": "That sounds lovely! I might put on a film with a great soundtrack."},
  {"speaker": "Marishus", "text": "Now I’m in the mood for something with a big, dramatic score."}
]

[
  {"speaker":"Corganette","text":"Traffic was weirdly quiet on my way back."},
  {"speaker":"Quakeselle","text":"Same here, barely had to slow down."},
  {"speaker":"Corganette","text":"Feels like the roads finally gave us a break."},
  {"speaker":"Quakeselle","text":"Yeah, not used to seeing them this clear."},
  {"speaker":"Corganette","text":"I kept expecting a jam around every turn."},
  {"speaker":"Quakeselle","text":"My dog's name is Brakin, by the way."},
  {"speaker":"Corganette","text":"At least the drive was painless for once."},
  {"speaker":"Quakeselle","text":"Totally, even the lights seemed to cooperate."},
  {"speaker":"Corganette","text":"I made it across town faster than I expected."},
  {"speaker":"Quakeselle","text":"That never happens at this hour."},
  {"speaker":"Corganette","text":"My favourite food is lasagna, honestly."},
  {"speaker":"Quakeselle","text":"Traffic might be the one thing behaving tonight."},
  {"speaker":"Corganette","text":"I've been getting into archery lately."},
  {"speaker":"Quakeselle","text":"Nice, maybe the roads will stay this calm."}
]

[
  {"speaker":"Corganette","text":"My rabbit's name is Fenix."},
  {"speaker":"Quakeselle","text":"I finally got a new phone, and the screen is so crisp."},
  {"speaker":"Corganette","text":"Nice! I love how light new phones feel."},
  {"speaker":"Quakeselle","text":"My boss is Neula."},
  {"speaker":"Corganette","text":"The new phone battery seems to last forever so far."},
  {"speaker":"Quakeselle","text":"That sounds great; mine charges so quickly."},
  {"speaker":"Corganette","text":"I keep tapping the screen just to admire it."},
  {"speaker":"Quakeselle","text":"I went to a tournament last Sunday."},
  {"speaker":"Corganette","text":"New phone cameras are kind of amazing now."},
  {"speaker":"Quakeselle","text":"Totally, the photos look sharp even indoors."},
  {"speaker":"Corganette","text":"I'm still getting used to the new keyboard."},
  {"speaker":"Quakeselle","text":"Same, autocorrect feels a little different on mine."},
  {"speaker":"Corganette","text":"The new phone fits better in my pocket, too."},
  {"speaker":"Quakeselle","text":"I like how smooth everything feels on this phone."}
]

[
  {"speaker": "Quakeselle", "text": "It's so bright out this morning, feels like a good day to get some air."},
  {"speaker": "Corganette", "text": "Right? The breeze is nice too, not too chilly."},
  {"speaker": "Quakeselle", "text": "I went to an audition yesterday, and I'm still thinking about it."},
  {"speaker": "Corganette", "text": "The sun finally came out, it's lovely."},
  {"speaker": "Quakeselle", "text": "Yeah, and the air feels so fresh today."},
  {"speaker": "Corganette", "text": "I hope it stays this mild all afternoon."},
  {"speaker": "Quakeselle", "text": "Same, it's such a nice change from gloomy skies."},
  {"speaker": "Corganette", "text": "My cousin is Pelus."},
  {"speaker": "Quakeselle", "text": "It's bright enough that I might sit by the window for a bit."},
  {"speaker": "Corganette", "text": "A little sunshine really makes the morning feel better."}
]

[
  {"speaker":"Corganette","text":"I finally cleared that tricky level in my game. The last puzzle had me stuck for ages."},
  {"speaker":"Quakeselle","text":"Nice! I've been replaying that cozy farming game, and it's such a good way to unwind."},
  {"speaker":"Corganette","text":"My dog Hasy has been curled up beside me all afternoon."},
  {"speaker":"Quakeselle","text":"I started a new adventure game and keep wandering off the main path to explore."},
  {"speaker":"Corganette","text":"Pelus grew up in Belwencombe and still talks about how quiet it was there."},
  {"speaker":"Quakeselle","text":"That sounds fun. I've been trying to beat the same boss without looking up any hints."},
  {"speaker":"Corganette","text":"I went to a hackathon last Saturday, and it was a really fun change of pace."},
  {"speaker":"Quakeselle","text":"I've been playing a little racing game lately; the short rounds are perfect for a quick break."},
  {"speaker":"Corganette","text":"Delganwyn enjoys chess and has apparently been practicing a lot lately."},
  {"speaker":"Quakeselle","text":"I might boot up that exploration game again; I still haven't found every hidden area."}
]

[
  {"speaker":"Corganette","text":"I was just thinking about my niece, Delganwyn."},
  {"speaker":"Quakeselle","text":"Did you catch the news? It feels like a lot to take in."},
  {"speaker":"Corganette","text":"Yeah, I skimmed a few headlines; hard to keep up."},
  {"speaker":"Quakeselle","text":"Same here. Every update seems to bring another update."},
  {"speaker":"Corganette","text":"I know, I keep checking and then wishing I hadn't."},
  {"speaker":"Quakeselle","text":"The nonstop headlines make a quiet chat feel nice."},
  {"speaker":"Corganette","text":"Totally. I might put the phone down for a bit."},
  {"speaker":"Quakeselle","text":"Good idea. The news will still be there later."},
  {"speaker":"Corganette","text":"I went to a regatta last Sunday, and it was a nice change of pace."},
  {"speaker":"Quakeselle","text":"True. I'm going to step away from the headlines too."}
]

[
  {"speaker":"Quakeselle","text":"Been playing that game again and finally cleared the tricky level. Those jumps are brutal lol."},
  {"speaker":"Corganette","text":"I went to a festival last Wednesday, and it was such a fun change of pace."},
  {"speaker":"Quakeselle","text":"Nice! I’m stuck on the boss fight now; I keep dodging way too early."},
  {"speaker":"Corganette","text":"Try waiting for the little pause before it swings. That helped me get through it."},
  {"speaker":"Quakeselle","text":"I live in Sovlinstead."},
  {"speaker":"Corganette","text":"That makes sense, I always panic when the screen flashes in that game."},
  {"speaker":"Quakeselle","text":"I keep replaying the opening area to find all the hidden stuff. It’s oddly relaxing."},
  {"speaker":"Corganette","text":"I like how much smoother the controls feel once you get used to them."},
  {"speaker":"Quakeselle","text":"Totally, the little shortcuts make exploring the game way more fun."},
  {"speaker":"Corganette","text":"I finally found one of those secret paths earlier. Felt very satisfying."},
  {"speaker":"Quakeselle","text":"My brother is Dorhaan, by the way."},
  {"speaker":"Corganette","text":"I’m still trying to nail that jump near the end of the level."},
  {"speaker":"Quakeselle","text":"You’ll get it! The game feels so good when you finally stick the landing."}
]

[

  {"speaker":"Loneald","text":"Yeah, and the updates keep changing by the hour. Hard to keep up."},
  {"speaker":"Wenan","text":"I know, I just skimmed a few headlines over lunch."},
  {"speaker":"Loneald","text":"Same here. The whole news cycle feels nonstop lately."},
  {"speaker":"Wenan","text":"At least there’s plenty to talk about while we catch up."},
  {"speaker":"Loneald","text":"True, though I could use a quieter news day for once."},
  {"speaker":"Wenan","text":"Same. I’m hoping the next headline is something cheerful."},
  {"speaker":"Loneald","text":"Random thing: my cat’s name is Feni."},
  {"speaker":"Wenan","text":"That’s a nice change of topic. The news could use more lighthearted stories."},
  {"speaker":"Loneald","text":"By the way, Ezyaek is my son."},
  {"speaker":"Wenan","text":"I hope the rest of the news today is a little less intense."}
]

  {"speaker":"Quakeselle","text":"I went to a workshop last Wednesday, and it was a nice change of pace."},
  {"speaker":"Corganette","text":"Have you tried that racing game? I keep replaying the same track to beat my time."},

  {"speaker":"Corganette","text":"I keep telling myself one more round, then suddenly it’s late."},

  {"speaker":"Quakeselle","text":"Neula’s dog is named Vipip, and Vipip loves curling up by the window."},
  {"speaker":"Corganette","text":"I’m trying a new strategy game, but I still haven’t figured out the best opening."},

]

[
  {"speaker": "Loneald", "text": "Traffic was crawling all the way home. What a slog."},
  {"speaker": "Wenan", "text": "Same here, it barely moved. I’m glad to be off the road now."},
  {"speaker": "Loneald", "text": "I went to a festival last Sunday, and it was a really fun day."},
  {"speaker": "Wenan", "text": "The roads have been so backed up lately. Even short trips take forever."},
  {"speaker": "Loneald", "text": "My roommate is Yaald."},
  {"speaker": "Wenan", "text": "I hit a long line of cars on the way back. So tiring."},
  {"speaker": "Loneald", "text": "Ezyaek's cat is named Gankin."},
  {"speaker": "Wenan", "text": "It’s still busy out there, even this late. Hope it clears soon."},
  {"speaker": "Loneald", "text": "My favourite food is risotto."},
  {"speaker": "Wenan", "text": "That drive took ages. I’m definitely staying in for the rest of the evening."},
  {"speaker": "Loneald", "text": "Traffic was rough on my way back too. Glad I made it home."},
  {"speaker": "Wenan", "text": "My rabbit’s name is Junsy."},
  {"speaker": "Loneald", "text": "The roads seem a little quieter now, thankfully."}
]
